messages:
release-coordinator: Kicking off the v3.4.1 release train. Note: global config rollout for rate-limiter will be staggered. Release freeze for any non-critical infra merges until 20:00 UTC. Please watch canaries and flags.
deploy-bot: Rolling canary: rate-limiter-config v3.4.1 -> eu-central (1/3) commit d4f9b2
ana: Heads-up: feature-flag rollout for 'adaptive-batching' scheduled at 19:50 UTC, will be toggled off automatically if errors >1% in 10m window.
chris: QA found a minor regression in the streaming connector in canary-1: occasional truncated chunks when payload >64KB. Logging now enabled for connector.
qa-lead: Thanks @chris. Can you paste logs here if you catch an instance? We'll validate against test harness.
sre-oncall: Seeing elevated 499s on eu-central-canary-1 starting ~19:36, looks correlated with connector truncation. Capturing traces.
incident-bot: Alert: 10m error rate for streaming-connector (eu-central-canary-1) = 1.7% > 1% threshold.
product-ops: We're going to pause feature-flag progress for adaptive-batching until connector fix lands. Notify support to hold visibility notes.
chris: Pushed a small fix to connector: commit e8a1c4. Request quick redeploy to canary-1.
deploy-bot: Redeploy started: streaming-connector e8a1c4 -> eu-central-canary-1
sre-oncall: Redeploy applied. Monitoring... 499s dropped to baseline, 5xx unchanged. Traces show timeouts resolved.
qa-lead: Running automated churn tests against canary-1. Will report pass/fail in 10m.
release-coordinator: Decision: proceed with config canary in eu-central only for now. Hold on wider rollout until QA signoff. Feature flags remain disabled.
ana: Noted. I'll delay adaptive-batching toggle.
product-ops: Scheduling rollback plan just in case: revert-script at https://internal/scripts/revert-rate-limiter.sh. Keep it handy.
incident-bot: Reminder: please annotate incidents with runbook tag `release-train-v3.4.1` when filing.
release-coordinator: Thanks everyone. Quick sync in 15m in #release-ops for status update. If QA passes, we'll authorize a second canary in us-west. :white_check_mark:
